text_block_list.text: One day, during training camp…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Trainer, do you have a minute?
choice_data_list: What's wrong?
What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Nothing, just… Can I borrow you for a second?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Okay, no one is around…
choice_data_list: Is there something you want to talk to me about?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Um, it's not a big deal, but about our training…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Tell it to me straight. What do you think is lacking in my performance?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Don't say "everything," though. That'd just make me sad.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I want to do some extra training, but first, I need your expert opinion. So lay it on me.
choice_data_list: Sure, but why all of a sudden?
Sure, but why all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: See, I'm behind all the others when it comes to training and race experience.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: But… I'm competing with Teio here, aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I know it's going to be super, super hard going up against her.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: So I want to be as ready as I can be.
Although still anxious about her prospects, it's clear Nice Nature is motivated. If that's the case, what I can say to her is…
choice_data_list: You should work on your core at the beach.
Let's do some mental training.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh… And what exactly do you mean?
I suggest that she train on the sand to strengthen her core, which can lead to more stability during races.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: That's true. A strong core is important. Okay, I'll do it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: All right, then I'm off to train. See ya la—
choice_data_list: But I'm not allowing any training by yourself.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: What? Why? You just gave me advice for it.
choice_data_list: I'll only allow it if I'm there with you.
I'll only allow it if I'm there with you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait… You want to join me for extra training?
choice_data_list: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Aw man, are you sure? Sorry… I'm sure you have other things you need to do.
choice_data_list: Nothing is more important than supporting you.
Nothing is more important than supporting you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You really don't hesitate saying cheesy things like that…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: M-mental training? What do you mean by that exactly?!
I suggest that she add time limits to her exercises to be more prepared for the pressure during races.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah, I get it now. I'm glad it wasn't some extreme method.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Okay, now that I got the gist of it, I'll get starte—
choice_data_list: But I'm not allowing any training by yourself.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: What? Why? You just gave me advice for it.
choice_data_list: I'll only allow it if I'm there with you.
I'll only allow it if I'm there with you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait… You want to join me for extra training?
choice_data_list: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Aw man, are you sure? Sorry… I'm sure you have other things you need to do.
choice_data_list: Nothing is more important than supporting you.
Nothing is more important than supporting you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You really don't hesitate saying cheesy things like that…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: All right! Let's get back to training.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Anyway, sorry to bother you. You can go back now if you want.
choice_data_list: Why did we have to come all the way over here?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Um, well, you know… I just figured this isn't something other people should hear.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I wanted to ask you about your top secret training routine, which I'm sure you don't want getting out.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Plus, I definitely don't want others to know that I'm doing this to compete with Teio.
It seems Nice Nature still isn't confident enough to openly compete with such a strong racer.
